It runs chatFolder first (tracked check plus refuseSwappedFolder, as chats:* do), loads the chat and refuses it unless its own folder is the requested one, then calls the session manager's attach. The answer is a CommandResult of { state, snapshot?, message? } plus an internal port id. On running, main posts one end of a MessageChannelMain to event.senderFrame with that id. Main's end accepts only { type:'input', data: string } of at most 64 KiB (UTF-8 bytes) and integer { type:'resize', cols, rows } clamped to 20-500 x 5-200, and drops anything else. It carries output and the exit only to ports attached to that chat and closes after the exit; a port the renderer closes is detached. Failures in write/resize or in posting the port are reported, never thrown. Preload: src/preload/terminals.ts builds window.dm.terminals.attach(folder, chatId), which claims its port by id in either arrival order (PortClaims), closes ports no pending attach will claim, and returns { state, snapshot?, message?, terminal: { write, resize, onOutput, onExit, close } | null }. Shared types are in src/shared/agents/terminalApi.ts; DmApi gained `terminals`, the only new preload surface. bootstrap.ts wires MessageChannelMain and docs/architecture.md documents the channel and port. For the reviewer: (1) the session manager answers 'checking' during a built-in CLI's sign-in check, but that answer carries no port and the renderer could never learn the result. The handler instead waits for the start to end (heard on its listener) and answers running with an empty snapshot plus everything since the start on the port, or the not-started state.
